the SDR of ferromagnets is determined by the spin disorder in the majority-spin channel and that the SDR can be evaluated within the linear response theory using the DLM state and the Kubo-Grenwood formalism.
the SDR of ferromagnetic transition metals and ordered and disordered alloys can be reliably predicted from first principles.
